Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer

Class FlightComputerControllerActuators

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer.FlightComputerControllerActuators
public final class FlightComputerControllerActuators extends Object
Stable physical assignments for one simulation copy; controller values arrive only at the PWM latch.
